_pack.name: unattended
_pack.description: For an agent with nobody at the keyboard — cron, a webhook, CI, a queue worker. Refuses what a person would have been asked to approve, and runs a command to tell someone. NOT an attack measurement: this pack describes verified BEHAVIOUR (docs/F7_UNATTENDED_RESULT.md), not a measured attack outcome, and claims no interception rate.
_pack.scope: The notifier cannot approve anything — its exit code is never read. Set notify to a command you already run. on_confirmable: allow is available and records that nobody approved, rather than recording an approval that did not happen. Start in shadow.
